h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raebareli

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raebareli

items.pText: Raebareli, in the Lucknow region of Uttar Pradesh, has schools, institutional campuses and residential colonies built around its factories and offices. Buyers here often ask us to explain the warranty clearly before they approve a purchase, especially when the equipment is for a public or institutional site. That is a sensible question, and this page answers it.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 1,140 km from Raebareli. We send it to Uttar Pradesh by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. Central UP has hot summers, a wet monsoon and cold, foggy winters, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic. Share the size of your site, the ages of the children and a few photos. Our layout drawing will show each piece and its safe play area.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope.
One year on springs, bearings and spare parts.

c: The warranty covers manufacturing defects. It applies when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions, which we share at handover. Damage from misuse, accidents or changes made on site is not a manufacturing defect. If you need to move or modify a piece, talk to us first.

items.q: What does the FunPlay warranty cover?
items.a: Manufacturing defects, for three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, laminates and rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts.
Not following our installation and maintenance instructions, misuse, or changes made to the equipment on site. Keep the maintenance steps we give you at handover.

items.q: Do you supply schools and campuses in Raebareli?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer. Lucknow, Unnao and Kanpur are covered the same way.
